Zugló (14. kerület) — Budapest, Hungary

Average day Average night

In detail

A large, mostly middle-class residential district (Városliget's eastern edge, Bosnyák tér). A 2022 police-data comparison found Zugló had the single highest residential-burglary count of any Budapest district (113 cases, roughly one burglary every three days), and a separate 2023 police map named the VII/XIV border area near Kerepesi Road and the Hungária Ring as a specific recurring burglary hotspot. Not named among the nightlife or violent-crime hotspots — a property-crime caution area. Sources checked: Index.hu, 16 May 2022 (district burglary comparison, PRE-STAT data); Infostart.hu, 21 Mar 2023 (police burglary-hotspot map).
